newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-ITALY SEEN ISSUING 12.25 TRLN LIRE BOTS.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-ITALY SEEN ISSUING 12.25 TRLN LIRE BOTS.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is expected to
issue some 12.25 trillion lire of short-term bills (BOT) at its
mid-month auction against 13.75 trillion worth of paper
maturing, a Reuter poll of analysts showed.
The forecasts ranged from a minimum 11.5 trillion lire worth
to 12.75 trillion lire.
The Treasury is also expected to issue its regular tranche
of 2.5 trillion lire of zero coupon certificates (CTZ).
"The Treasury will continue its policy of issuing less BOT
bills than the amount expiring. The trend remains one of
reducing short-term debt," one analyst said.
The Treasury will announce on Friday the amount of paper it
will offer at the December 11 auction. Settlement date is
December 16.
Following are the analysts' forecasts (in trillion lire):
